scope: Element-aware CPU runtime tensor descriptors, typed validation/retention/copies and scalar task layouts, shared by the private CPU/Metal storage bridge.

semantics.types: All ten core numeric types map to fixed-width C++ storage and actual target alignment. Arithmetic remains float32-only.
semantics.abi: CpuTensor<Element,Rank> keeps the MLIR memref field layout; rank zero omits dimension arrays. Float32Tensor remains its float32 alias. Numeric tags belong to separate native adapter views, not memref fields.
semantics.views: Raw CPU adapter views default to an invalid type. Typed descriptor views supply an explicit element tag. Validation checks dense strides, shape, width-aware offsets, alignment, backing identity and complete bounds.
semantics.retention: Successful retention snapshots dimensions and takes an immutable allocation lease; storage survives source owner/context destruction. Empty values do not dereference or retain addresses.
semantics.copies: Exact element/rank/byte checks precede allocation. Canonical strides are overflow-checked and independent owned storage preserves bits without conversion.
semantics.scalar_layouts: Distinct layouts carry each concrete type, width and alignment. Float32 preserves its private layout identity and shares one canonical object with the Metal reduction/CPU bridge. Scheduler exact-layout checks reject same-width type mismatches.
semantics.metal: Only the existing float32/uint32/uint8 storage formats map to the bridge. Typed exports reject mismatches, unsupported formats and residency before publication; integer storage does not enable integer arithmetic.
semantics.ownership: Existing Invocation allocation leases and scheduler cleanup remain in use. Metal charges the complete retained allocation, including subview prefix/suffix storage.
semantics.remaining: Additional source numeric arithmetic and compiler operator/literal/conversion lowering are not enabled. Next is checked CPU int32 qualification.

coverage: all numeric widths and host alignments
exact scalar task results and repeated reads
full existing compiled float32/task lifecycle regression

distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Runtime storage/ABI correctness increment; no speedup claim.
